evidence_quote: ALDH5A1 sequencing revealed compound heterozygosity for 2 previously described mutations: c.1015-2A.C (mutation of canonical splice-site) and c.608C.G; p.(Pro203Arg).
note: Index case described in detail; three other adult deaths (ages 33, 19, mid-20s) are mentioned briefly; adult cohort otherwise aggregate.

evidence_quote: Results: Seven subjects were consented and enrolled in the NIH. Mean age was 20 years at enrollment (range 12-33) and 2/7 (29 %) were female.
note: Close call: trial results are aggregate; only passing unnamed mentions (one patient's new-onset seizure, one on carbamazepine).

evidence_quote: These findings led to ALDH5A1 sequencing which revealed homozygous c.608C>T; pPro203Leu mutations, previously described as disease causing, in both subjects.
note: Twins reported; Table 1 lists literature cases by country only, not per patient.

evidence_quote: We quantified GHB in hair derived from ten patients with SSADHD, and documented a significant negative age correlation.
note: Close call: per-patient hair GHB only in a figure; text mentions one blond 3-year-old patient's hair GHB, otherwise aggregate.

evidence_quote: SUDEP occurred in a single patient in this cohort, a boy age 14 years with compound heterozygosity for ALDH5A1 variants c.1015-2A>C and c.1005C>A (p.Asn335Lys).
note: 24-patient cohort mostly aggregate; at least 4 described individually (3 with genotype), but the daily-seizure patient may or may not be the 8-year-old girl.

evidence_quote: We recruited 18 patients with SSADHD [age: 2-39 years; median: 7 years (inter-quartile range: 4-12.5); 8 females] from the ongoing SSADHD Natural History Study led by Boston Children's Hospital.
